tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: Lists the 18 versions of DoubleTaxation. Each version is written for taxpayers of one home state (in its language) and compares it with 21 other countries. Call this first if you are not sure which version fits the user.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Lists the countries that can be checked against the home state of a version: whether a tax treaty is in force (title, dates, link), whether per-income treaty rules and tax burden data exist, plus the allowed citizenship options and years for check_residency.

tools.name: check_residency
tools.description: Determines the person's tax residence between the version's home state and another country, step by step. tools.name: exit_tax_check
tools.description: Whether a country levies an exit (departure) tax on individuals who give up tax residence: who pays and on what (assets, thresholds, prior residence period), deferral or relief (e.g. moving within the EU/EEA), the legal norm with a link and the date checked.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_versions" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Lists the 12 versions of DoubleTaxation. Each version is written for taxpayers of one home state (in its language) and compares it with 20 other countries. Call this first if you are not sure which version fits the user." → after: "Lists the 18 versions of DoubleTaxation. Each version is written for taxpayers of one home state (in its language) and compares it with 21 other countries. Call this first if you are not sure which version fits the user."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
